snippet.title: Husk of Axiom - Reveal Trailer | Wishlist now!
snippet.description:
➜ 🧿 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348010/Husk_of_Axiom/

Husk of Axiom - Reveal Trailer 

Husk of Axiom is a 2.5D turn-based psychological RPG, where human belief gives life to magic and monsters. As a secretive organization tries to erase pain from the world, a small party of unlikely heroes has to save reality by preserving not perfection, but the imperfect humanity that gives it life.
